To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a Large Liquid Scintoilator Detector can be used to measure sin 22θ13 with a sensitivity that is comparable to that of Double Chooz and can achieve a sensitivity that is better by an order of magnitude with a mobile reactor, and that it can be used to determine sin 22θ 12 and Δm 212 with a precision that is comparable to current data.

a Large Liquid Scinterillator Detector can measure the small mixing angle with a mobile reactor, that the precision that can achieved for the solar neutrino oscillation parameters is comparable to the precision from current global fit analyses, and that the detector could be used to search for CP violation in the lepton sector.

a mobile nuclear reactor, such as a ship, or a submarine, or an icebreaker is a powerful new source of reactor neutrinos for oscillation experiments, and that a large liquid scintillator detector, such as JUNO or RENO50, is a very suitable detector for these measurements, because of its large mass and its high efficiency for the reactor antineutrino spectrum.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of new experiments that will provide important information on the neutrino mass hierarchy, the solar neutrino oscillation parameters, and the mixing angle θ13.
the design and optimization of future reactor neutrino oscillations experiments.
the physics potential of reactor neutrino oscillations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a mobile reactor can achieve a precision on the solar parameters that is comparable to current data, but a mobile e source can be competitive with the next generation of reactor experiments.
the mobile reactor is the best solution for the determination of the small mixing angles θ12 and θ13.

, while a mobile e source, such as an icebreaker or a submarine, is an ideal setup for measuring sin 22θ13, it is not ideal for a precision measurement of the solar parameters, and a conventional power reactor would be a better choice for that purpose.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the mobile reactor is a very promising option for a measurement of small mixing angle θ130.004 at a 90% C.L., and that a mobile reactor or a conventional power reactor is a good choice for a precision measurement of the solar parameters.
a large liquid scintillator detector can be used to measure the small mixing angle with a mobile source, to test theoretical models and to improve the precision of the solar oscillation parameters.
, with a mobile e reactor, a precision of 0.4% for θ13 and 1.2% for the solar parameters can be achieved.
The main takeaway from our work is that
reactor neutrino experiments can achieve very precise measurements of the neutrino oscillation parameters, and that a Large Liquid Scitillator Detector can play a major role in this field.
a mobile e source can provide a powerful probe of neutrino properties, especially for the small mixing angle.
a mobile reactor can provide a very competitive alternative to current and future experiments.
